Sewer Turtle Whistle is contained in the Turtle's Thanks satchel at in the Stoneshaper's Atrium of Dornogal. To begin, find a Dalaran Sewer Turtle at southwest of Freywold Village on the Isle of Dorn, then give it 5x Dornish Pike. Briefly leave the area and return, then give it a Goldengill Trout. After that, head to Stoneshaper's Atrium and speak with the Dalaran Sewer Turtle one final time to spawn the satchel. Once summoned, the sewer turtle is special in that it spawns with one of four colored scarves each time it spawns!

in Meesk's Retreat.]] Shadecasters are devices used by the nerubian to project orders and messages from their high-ranking leaders, play recorded messages, and as propaganda tools. During the Ascendance Day, a new holiday ordained by Queen Ansurek to revel in their newfound, void-infused evolution, the streets of the City of Threads were lined with shadecasters broadcasting propaganda about ascending. Executor Nizrek eventually tasked the adventurers with revealing the truth about ascension and gave them a device that could overwrite their messages.

Shatter Defenses is a melee damage dealer-oriented buff available to players on the highest difficulty tier of Titan Rune Dungeon in World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King Classic. Upon activating Protocol Gamma, players receive a Signet of the Silver Covenant or Signet of the Sunreaver which summons an NPC to grant one of four possible buffs. These buffs have no duration, and the Signets can be re-used if the buff is lost. The other buffs are: * Rallying Cry of the Tournament Champion (ranged) * Confessor's Wrath (healer) * Shield of Thorns (tank) A standard five-player party will automatically have the tank and healer buffs and at least one damage dealer buff. A number of shop items were introduced in World of Warcraft since the first item, the Celestial Steed mount, was introduced in . This page aims to list every shop item available now and those that were removed in a collective list. Most shop items can be purchased from either the online Battle.net Shop or through the In-Game Shop while some items were only available through other means such as the original Blizzard Store. Trading Post items may appear on the shops as a first time availability but items that were originally offered from the post in the past can still appear.

Siren Isle, known as Cyrandall to the Vrykul, is a storm-wracked island. During the Fourth War, it was used by Kul Tiras to mine :Azerite, but since then its inhabitants have mysteriously disappeared. The goblins, Arathi, and earthen have all ventured there, drawn by a mysterious whispering crystal. The Bloodwake vrykul, Darktide naga, and Bilge Rats pirates vie for control of the isle.

Snix Longpocket is a goblin located in the Incontinental Hotel in the Undermine. During the Liberation of Undermine, Snix sets up shop in the Tailgate Park just outside the Demolition Dome across the way from Skitto Screwjack. They both sell items required for The Splash Zone.

Snakelets! concludes the "A Slither of Snakes" chapter of the Otherworldly Ecologist storyline for Ecological Succession, and thus awards the achievement. Ve'nari continues the greater Ecological Succession campaign by starting Eco-Stability immediately after.

Smooth Stones are looted from Enraged Crushers, Shattered Rumblers, and Tortured Earth Spirits all over Nagrand in Outland. Hemet Nesingwary wants them for Comfort Stones and More Cozy Beds as part of the Otherworldly Ecologist questline for Ecological Succession.
Snarled Brambles are magical roots summoned by grells in order to hold Grizzleweald young. They are found on furbolg homes' doors in Grizzleweald in Val'sharah.
Snickering Ripples are pandaren spirits found in Island Expeditions.
Smuggler's Lynxeye is a scope made with Midnight Engineering, discovered through the Recycling ability.

Sneaky Servitors are six stealthed dredgers found on piles of poop at the Grand Walk in Castle Nathria. They are unattackable. When players who are targeted by Shriekwing's Echolocation ability stand on their locations, pools of Sanguine Ichor will be left by Shriekwing, which will kill these dredgers.
Sne'ix the Egg Tender is a skitterling located in the Burrows in the City of Threads.
Snuggle Buddy is located in a canoe on an island in the western Emerald Dream.
Soaring Behemoths are massive fathom rays flying in eastern Hallowfall.

The Sparklit are a group of kobolds found in the Lost Mines in the Ringing Deeps. They are led by Cogchewer and serve the Candle King. During the war in Khaz Algar, Cogchewer and his minions were rebuilding ironstriders, which the Machine Speakers had left behind when the mines fell, for war. They were also in charge of defending the mines. Skitter and Speaker Brinthe had adventurers destroy the ironstriders and defeat Cogchewer to take his keys.
Spaulders of Arrow's Flight drop from the Restless Heart in Windrunner Spire.
Sparkleshell Clackers are crabs found in Island Expeditions.
